title: NVIDIA adds content-safety, topic-control and jailbreak-detection NIM microservices to NeMo Guardrails for agents
summary: On 16 January 2025 NVIDIA released three NIM microservices for NeMo Guardrails, framed as safeguards for agentic AI applications: a content safety service trained on the Aegis Content Safety Dataset of over 35,000 human-annotated samples, a topic control service that keeps conversations on approved topics, and a jailbreak detection service that protects against attempts to bypass the system's restrictions. NVIDIA described them as small language models that offer lower latency, named Amdocs, Cerence AI and Lowe's as NeMo Guardrails users, and pointed to its open-source Garak toolkit for scanning LLM applications for prompt injection and jailbreak vulnerabilities.
